title: Content Addressing in Plain Terms
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Content Addressing in Plain Terms.
learning_objectives: Explain content addressing in plain terms using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for content addressing in plain terms

concepts_covered: A CID is a content-derived label; it says what content is addressed, not where a copy is currently stored.
cidFromBytes hashes input bytes and assembles a CIDv1 raw-codec value; local addressing does not provide network replication.
